steps.name: Medea's visit
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Glinda] in “Dorothy Village.”

steps.name: how to open the way
steps.objective: Talk to [Glinda] in “Dorothy Village” and defeat [Repika] in “Moksha” to obtain <Highland White Herb>. Then report the quest to [Glinda] in “Dorothy Village.”

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I guessed it, but… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Glinda, thank you for waiting for me to bring up my story. Actually, I was a little worried. You might stop me from coming... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: There's no reason to stop someone who doesn't have any hostile intentions. You are not Daphne.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, the story you want to tell is... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I guess I should leave. Let's talk comfortably.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Glinda, you are welcome to listen as well.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then let me listen. Medea, you too, have a cup of tea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. It smells good.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, if you don't mind, could you take a moment with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this something I should help you with? Daphne left behind... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: At some point, he continued to leave clues that only I could see and feel.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's as if it's telling you to find something hidden.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So, whenever I had time, I searched for the footsteps of my ancestors left behind in Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you talking about Creed?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… . They may have been spirits like Kali's ancestors.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They were born into life and had unique powers, but when evil people found out about them, they began to use them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In Eastland, a hero from another world turned many lives, including the Kali clan, into magic stones to save his world, and attempted to destroy our world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Vice….)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Ha, Lux goes around doing things like that in Freios... . %s I don't even want to imagine what would have happened if it wasn't for that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As always, thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Thank you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will tell you next. You probably know that Creed's children have been victims for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … I know.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Probably because Daphne tolerated it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have to face Daphne again, one way or another. Now seems like the right time... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This might be a promise I made to that person when I was young.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Promise… ?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He told me to find my own will someday when the time comes. As a child, I thought it was just a game of hide and seek... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Right now, I have to do my own thing, and you have to do your own thing to stop that person... . Anyway, all the clues I gathered pointed to one place.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: However, it is difficult for me to go alone. I need help from %s.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Media, by any chance, do you mean Lindos?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Lindos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lindos? Where is it?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: There is a legend that a giant who followed the gods lived there before the twilight years.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It is a place located north of Alfheim, and entry is currently prohibited. At one time, it was called a sacred place and was visited by many people because it was said to have the energy of God.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then, demons and demons suddenly appeared, causing casualties, and the Dokalf priests sealed the road as they took care of the situation.
(Elliot, who was passing by, stops as if he heard the story.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It looks like Daphne is hiding something somewhere in there.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: After all, that's where it was hidden... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must not be an ordinary place.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A rabbit with a lot to hide always goes into a deep burrow.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Hmm… . wait for a sec. Did you ask %s for help because of a legend? Because you are a follower of God?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of legend is it?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: There is a story that a group called warriors discovered a giant's weapon there.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Medea, even if you follow this legend to Lindos, the chances of finding it are slim. Still, if it was Daphne's plan... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It probably also includes why you came here.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I had a vague guess. I knew it was a witch who had made some sort of deal with Dorothy, but I never thought it was Daphne.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sorry… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Medea, you have nothing to be sorry about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, you don't know exactly what to look for, do you?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I guess I'll have to go and find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So when should we leave?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, you can't sit still either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As I said before, I have to do something to feel at ease.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: But what should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: As I said a moment ago, there is no way to get to Lindos from anywhere in Freios right now.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The road was sealed... It was made so that no one could find it.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: So we have to force the road.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Glinda, you know how. If you need to make something, I'll go and get the ingredients.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Once you get all the ingredients, we can open the road to Lindos. Well then, go slowly.

steps.name: take a break
steps.objective: After talking to [Glinda] in “Dorothy Village,” go forward to [Runo]. Then report the quest to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have obtained the ingredients as Glinda said.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Highland White Herb… . This is enough. Well done, you two.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Originally, I needed materials from Emeraldia, but luckily there are replacement materials so there shouldn't be any problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Emeraldia… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Now all that's left is combination.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: How about waiting while your condition recovers?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay. %s is ok too, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Okay. Until then, let me rest properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel somewhat scared... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Hahahaha, don't worry. Because I won't kill you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please take care of me then, Glinda.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: %s, he said the boss would be coming soon. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Runo.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you for your consideration during our stay. Thanks to you, I had a comfortable stay.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I'm glad you had a good time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bina and Leticia. I told you there was no need to see me off.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: A. Otherwise, you'll regret it later. Meow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to Dorothy's village with her, but I felt like she was leaving me alone.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's okay. You're just visiting for a short while. I will be training hard in the meantime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Water lily?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, I have to work harder when I get back. I decided to organize Bina and Munchkin's warehouse for training.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Sister, leave me out. It's hard to organize the warehouse.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I already reported to Glinda that I will properly organize the warehouse with Bina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Letty, I'll be back as soon as I can. We have to go back to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right. That's how it should be.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Medea, please be careful too.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: No? Then, am I your sister?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will be your older sister. thank you.
(Media smiles slightly at Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I made you wait. I already used it, but I still went to the warehouse to check.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it in the warehouse?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Mandarava has to be outside the village first. I placed an attribute crystal similar to the Imperial Gate inside the mandalaba.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When the gate connecting Alfheim Village and the region was broken, I combined what I had with the materials I brought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should Mandarava do?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's not about what Mandarava does. you have to do it Pick it up with both hands and throw it with all your might toward the north.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Throw it with all your might.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, this sounds fun.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Where Mandarava falls, the road to the north will open.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yeah. And you just have to wait until Mandarava comes back.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mom, that… Do you know about Mandarava?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Still, the boss recently acquired the highest quality cotton. It looks like Mandarava is also looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since the spirit likes cotton, that method is possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think everyone understands it too easily...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I will go to the road and meet Mandarava. I'll be back, Glinda.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: What did I do? Take care of yourselves. That's enough.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I hope everything goes well.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Please come back.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. goodbye.
(The people of Dorothy's village turn around after seeing off Medea and Adventurer. Meanwhile, Bina seems to have remembered something and stops and grabs Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Sister Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I couldn't see Elliot. Did you happen to see him?

steps.name: Great Spirit's Help
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road” and report the quest to [Media] in “Lindos Shrine.”

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I am a perfect herbal spirit that no one can stop!  Lie down warmly and enjoy the sunlight~♬
(Mandarava is lying down next to a rock and singing a strange song.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You were here. Spirit.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wow, this is a surprise!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you having fun looking for all the herbs?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Anyone who sees it will think that it is a spirit that does not work and plays.
(As Mandarava shakes his body, Mandrake shows his face through the zipper.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I caught a herb that had run away! Hehe~

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Didn't the Mandrake run away because you advised her to be a senior herbalist?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: He said he was a teacher, not a senior.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I didn't mean it in a bad way. Medea, please say something.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Maybe it's because Mandrake heard the spirit's story, but he seems to be in a good mood.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Really? As expected, Medea understands my deep meaning. Ahem.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I don't think you guys came out looking for herbs. Are you leaving?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Isn’t this the road to Alfheim? How are you going to get there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you do as Glinda says, a road will be created on Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If you do as Glinda says, a path will be created? I get it. Then, please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Mandarava. Don't you know how?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems like the spirit doesn't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda recently bought the highest quality cotton... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Ooooh! As expected, that cotton was mine!!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Glinda was talking about the new cotton and said that I could talk to the spirit.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You need the help of the wonderful Mandarava, the herb spirit. What should I do? Come on, come on!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, Mandarava.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: What are you sorry about? uh? Why are you holding on to me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You'll find out soon enough.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Huh? Ugh! uh! Wow!!
(Even before Mandarava has time to say anything, he is thrown towards the north.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The spirit... It flies like a star in the sky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know it would fly that far... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad that my stamina has recovered enough to throw the spirit far away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your concern. In fact, they say he fell asleep for a week, but I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It looks fine on the outside, but if you feel anything strange or difficult, please let me know right away.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s. There's something sparkling in the direction the spirit flew... . Can you see it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's true! It's shining over there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It looks like the road has been made.
(At that time, Mandarava is carried by the wind and flies in front of Adventurer and Mediah.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, so bad! I threw such a wonderful herb spirit and had it rolling around on the border of Gado!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Is it really necessary to build the road to Lindos like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was the method that Glinda said.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: As expected, Glinda. This is a great method.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Spirit, thank you for your understanding.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Medea, I'm fine as long as I have new cotton. Just new cotton... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Then I will kindly let you know!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If you go straight that way, you'll be heading towards Alfheim Lindos. But it's dangerous there, will you two be okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's already a strange place full of strange kids, but it's going to be even more complicated since Daphne said she went there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I'll find out once I go.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: This wonderful spirit will be here waiting for you to return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll come back.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Spirit, see you later.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Bye bye.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Everyone has gone. It looks like Elliot is going somewhere too... . Are you going to a witch's nest?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Hey, I don’t know. All I have to do is bask in the sun. Ah, it’s warm ahhh~.

steps.name: Steps to the Holy Land
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in “Lindos Shrine” and kill [Kru Kru] and [Peaceful Decarabi]. Then report the quest to [Hilda] in “Lindos Holy Land.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, From here you enter the Lindos Sanctuary.
(Medea moves forward through the large flowers with her staff. Then, a sort of path appears that can be squeezed between the rocky hills.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've traveled all over the Freios continent, but this is my first time visiting a place like this.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is it because it is a place where there were giants? Everything is big.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's definitely a restricted area. If you see a sign saying not to enter... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea?
(Mediah raises her head and gazes at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The sacred site of Lindos is filled with an ominous feeling. also… It looks like there's someone who doesn't welcome us.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Moreover, it seems that there are not just one or two witches.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch? Could it be Daphne?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No, definitely not Daphne. That person wouldn't leave a trace like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … I'm not sure who it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If it is a witch that Medea knows other than Daphne...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… . Why are you like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm a little dizzy.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, for now… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you are not feeling well, it is better to rest... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Medea. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay. However, don't push yourself too hard.

steps.name: Different but same purpose
steps.objective:
1. Chase [Hilda], who has disappeared somewhere in the Lindos Holy Land. 
2. When you find [Hilda] and the situation is over, kill [Positive Tyren], return to your original location, and report the quest to [Hilda].

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ugh… .
(Hilda falls to the floor, holding her head.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought I could hide here without anyone worrying... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Damn… , Is that guy coming…? ?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You shouldn't be here... . I have to go… .
(Hilda raises her head and looks ahead as if sensing something)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Daphne… … ? No… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … I have to hide... . You can't stay here like this. If it stays like this... … . Ugh… .
(Hilda struggles to get up, looks around, and quickly leaves before anyone spots her.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Where did you go? I was definitely here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think he knew I was coming and hid somewhere.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, are you okay now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to you, I feel better. It's hard to explain, but I don't think I just recovered.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It just calmed my soul. Sort of… It's my ability... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I didn't realize it when I was young. My abilities were revealed this way because Daphne wanted it... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Maybe I can help Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then maybe I can have a long talk with Hilda. I need to know why you're here.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You wanted to talk to Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I followed traces of witches, Hilda was always there. And what Hilda said to Iris bothers me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What Kazno and Jeryl are trying to do may have unexpected results for everyone... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: First, I need to find Hilda. The best way to be sure is to hear it in person.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It hurts… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why should I be the only one who feels this pain? Why do I have to run away... … .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why only me... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don’t like it… . I don't want to face the end like this... … … .
(At that moment, the figure of %s, who was following her, appears in Hilda's field of vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda. wait for a sec!

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Stay right there. Don't come closer!!
(Hilda's eyes turn sharp as her emotions explode into unbearable conditions. At the same time, the space around her begins to distort.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I’m dizzy… . Stop it, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What are you? You've never been like that before. Why are you… … .  Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You two, step back!!
Boom.
(Medea, who was following, sticks her staff into the floor. At that moment, the vibration shaking the space stops and the two people who were facing each other fall down on the spot.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is everyone okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, I’m okay… . Hilda… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, please step back for a moment. I'll talk to Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(As Adventurer takes a step back, Medea quietly walks towards Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Among those with the fate of the Black Moon, there is no one who does not know you. You can't touch it carelessly... . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, come to me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you won't come, I will go.
(Medea approaches Hilda, who hesitates.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please bow your head for a moment.
(Medea raises her staff and taps Hilda on the shoulder. Then, a small light blooms from the tip of the staff and surrounds Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This will be fine for the time being.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: How did they do it?
(Hilda looks up at Medea with confused eyes.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why do you do me this favor? They might try to kill me like other witches... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I could have done that if I wanted to, but I didn't have to. There's no need to do it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And I know you won't die quietly.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you're in Glinda's village, you know that not all witches have to be enemies.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's right. But, I don't understand why he came with that guy. Medea, you know that, right? About me and that guy's soul... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's why I can't believe it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To some extent, I guessed it. But, that doesn't change anything.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, it seems like you came to Lindos for a different purpose... . At this rate, it will remain like this for as long as we remain in Lindos.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s also had similar symptoms as Hilda, so I helped her recover.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It doesn't get better simply by recovering.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I know. But that doesn't mean you can't stay sick forever.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: No way, Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, come this way. Hilda is fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while since I've seen you like this.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … As expected, as Mediah said, it seems to be okay.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, did you mean to find something Daphne was hiding?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Daphne didn't hide it, but she told me to go here to find what I needed.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The goals are different, but the path to get there is probably the same... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda and Medea are here, so you both will be fine.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I will go separately.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, since there is something in Lindos that you say you are looking for, leaving like this will make things difficult for everyone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And there's something only %s can do.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It sounds like coming to Lindos would be meaningless without that guy... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I guess that’s right, haha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, wait… .
(Everyone looks at the same place at the same time, as if they had made a promise to each other.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The movement of monsters has changed.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: follow me

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: He said there was something to find.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Let's go, %s. I think you can check it there.

steps.name: A being eaten by the abyss
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Shrine」 and enter 「Helepol Fortress」.
2. Defeat [Dmitri] at 「Hellepol Fortress」 and obtain <Rage Turned to Ash>. Then report the quest to [Hilda] in “Lindos Holy Land.”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This is how they welcome us.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. nothing. I thought there was something big over there.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There seems to be something inside Hellepol Fortress.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hellepol Fortress?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s. Look east along this road. There are a lot of stone statues erected, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, those statues… . Could it be the appearance of an ancient god? There is also a statue of a goddess that has a similar feel to Ceres.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's Hellepol Fortress. It was created by a giant who followed the gods before the Twilight Age.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The giant who made weapons?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, that's right. The giant was very dexterous and could make anything.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Originally, it was a temple-like place built to commemorate the achievements of the gods, but as time passed, people who had nowhere else to go began to come and stay.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It is said that during the twilight years, several ancient gods came down here to escape something.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It is said that many gods stayed in the place created by the giant because it was considered safe. It is said that it became a place that saved the lives of many people after that... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now it has become a place full of monsters, including demons and demons... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a place like that... . I didn't know. By the way, Medea, how do you know the story about the giant?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When I was young... . He told me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The strange witch is here again.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If it wasn't okay, I wouldn't have come all the way from Cali.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know Kali Village.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I went out with Daphne for a while. I heard it then. There was a lovely child in that village whom I cherished very much.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Daphne usually doesn't show her emotions, but she was very happy when she talked about Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When did you go out with Daphne?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Even before the final battle of Avalon. If I wanted to avoid Ouroboros, I had no choice but to go with someone as capable as Daphne.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: First, let’s address the purpose of coming here. don't worry. Because it won’t disappear like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You're not going in? I don't think it's normal what's inside... . Aren't you ready yet?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The evil energy flows out here and stings my nose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is inside Hellepol Fortress? . Uh, Medea?
(Mediah taps Hilda and %s on the shoulders with her cane.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you move together without overdoing it, you'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don't know how long it will take, but please take care of it. I'll take the lead here. Now, follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.
(As you go up the stairs where the two goddess statues stand, you can see the inside of the canyon, which is deeper than the Lindos Shrine.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Are all those things over there just stone statues? They are erected wherever you can see the cliff. Is that giant statue looking inside?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A giant made this all by himself... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It looks like a sacred place, but you can feel evil energy everywhere.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems to be poisonous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, is there a miasma here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't you feel it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought it was because you were a bit dull, but it turned out that Mediah had excellent recovery abilities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Am I dull?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't worry about such trivial things.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Both of you look ahead.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Something black is flying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Well. Let's check it out.
(As soon as she hears Hilda's words, Medea adjusts her staff and holds it. Hilda also takes out a small dagger from her bosom and stands guard.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, you don't do anything now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: First, I have to check something. Later, when I signal, you will attack.
(With those words, something black flies and stops moving in front of the group.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Devil… ? No, it's a demon statue.
(The demonic figure exudes ominous energy and looks at the group.)
「Kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk.」
(A bizarre sound of laughter comes from the face of a stone statue that looks like a skull.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't think it's the gatekeeper gargoyle... .
“How dare you compare this body to something like a gargoyle? You fools. “Go back.”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'll go back when I'm done with my work.
“I, Dmitri, do not allow you to enter Hellepol.”
(A stone statue named Dmitri raises his sword and points it at the group.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “If you don’t go back, I will cut you all down here.”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You're good at saying the obvious. I have no intention of keeping you alive anyway. Isn't that right, Dmitry?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “How dare you recklessly bring up the name of a great being on a mortal topic?”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Since you talk about being mortal, your identity is so obvious, isn't it? don't worry. It was okay to post the name of someone worse than you.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Who did you say that was?”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Goddess of the Black Moon.
(With Hilda’s answer, Dmitry swings the sword he was holding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .
(%s Although the party avoids Dmitry's attack, they are pushed back significantly due to the strong impact.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Do you think Hecate has a grudge?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk… .」

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “This is the tribe that she created. “I will kill every single one of you.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, is that stone statue… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm not sure, but it looks like the twisted person is trapped in the statue. If you see what he's doing, it's like the devil... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone be careful!!
(A blade-like wind emerges from the tip of Dmitry's sword and attacks the group.)
(Hilda and Medea try to fight back, but strangely, their attacks bounce back as if they were blocked by something.)
(I tried this several times, but the two attacks were helplessly unable to reach me.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The Black Moon Goddess is no help at all. But it's okay.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk… . Hecate's people.  Do you think the energy of the black moon will reach the great Dmitri? It might buy you some time, but... .」
Boom.
(Something falls under Dmitry with a loud sound.)
(Dmitri holds one shoulder and looks down at the arm of the demon statue on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “There was one more annoying thing. I'm curious about your name, but I won't ask. What is the use of learning the names of people who will die anyway? . 」

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “I said that no god or any god’s creatures can touch it. Haha.”
(With Dmitry's exasperated sigh, the destroyed left arm regenerates.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “I was thinking of dealing with him moderately and showing him some mercy, but I guess that won’t work.”

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Don’t even think about getting out of Hellepol Fortress alive.”
(Dmitry slowly flaps his wings and flies into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Are you running away?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “How can a foolish mortal understand the meaning of a great being?”

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “I will wait there. There is no better place for your soul to suffer.”
(With those words, the surroundings become dark. The darkness quickly disappeared, but the demon statue in front of me was nowhere to be found.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's tempting us.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, can I use just one leaf from the wand?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. But where are you going to use it? .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I somehow feel like I need it... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where are you trying to use it...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Hilda. How did you know my attack would work on Dmitry?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You said there are things only you can do. I just thought maybe that was it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Do I literally have to use force? ha… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I like it because it’s simple.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know what's going on where Dmitri is, but... , I have to go first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: They said he was a great being, but I guess he had a hard time doing it on his own. The devils and demons who have been hiding until now are coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, please move forward.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yeah. okay. And Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay. Then let's go.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I have no personal grudges. It was just a mistake to attack me.
(The demon that fell at Hilda's feet screams and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … With this, all the monsters that were chasing us retreated.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I just need to find Dmitri... . %s, don't relax yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Hilda. however… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why don't Hilda and Medea's attacks work on Dmitri?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I have a guess. I think I made some kind of promise or contract.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sure so.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: But Hecate probably didn't promise not to harm Dmitri in any way.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hecate, the master of Elysia, rarely attacks other gods in Elysia. If they attacked, they were probably trying to protect a precious space.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We were influenced only by Hecate. If not… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Is it because of the statue that Dmitry is trapped in? Something that no god or the power of any being can affect... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you think of giants, it seems quite possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then my attacks shouldn't work either.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes, Iris.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: In the meantime, no one has become a god except Iris. I don't know if I should call that a variable... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Two minutes. Look ahead.
(The moment the party looks forward, the entire surrounding space is filled with dark shadows.)
(And from that gap, a demonic statue emitting evil flames appears.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “You’ve managed to come this far. “Children of Hecate.”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ugh, it’s a terrible poison… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. This is the poison I mentioned earlier. It's amazing... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It exudes a venom stronger than that of a high-ranking demon born from the abyss.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “As I promised, I will kill you here. “I look forward to seeing Hecate’s face as she watches you die.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what happened with Hecate, but it has nothing to do with us. Let me find only what I need and leave.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “You may be like that, but I am not. You guys don't know. The feeling of being trapped in a demon statue and becoming a demon due to Hecate... !」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hecate wouldn't have that kind of hobby... . Well, it's purely a personal grudge.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So just killing us is enough?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “I will kill you, go out and burn the Continent of Freios like in the twilight days... … .」
(After hearing those words, Hilda grabs Medea and %s's hands and hurriedly backs away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's no longer the twisted one. He's just a devil who jumped into the abyss on his own.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Keu, he’s a pretty smart guy. I thought she was weak and stupid like Hecate... . “Kyaaak!”
(Evil flames explode around Dmitri and surround him.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The reason our attack didn't work... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The statue itself was made that way. So as not to be destroyed by any being. And so that only certain people can be destroyed... .

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “It seems like a human called a hero has come in search of the giant’s legacy… .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened to them?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Half of them died and gave their souls to me, and half of them ran away. Now that I think about it, you resemble a lot of the warriors back then. Kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hero….)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Offer all your souls to me!! “Everyone, die right here so I can kill Hecate!!”
(At that moment, Dmitry rushes towards the group. Meanwhile, in the distance, from high above, a boy looks down and laughs.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: It seems a little different from what I know... .

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Well, it doesn't matter. Anyway, the winner is on our side. cheer up.
(Dmitry's tail and wings are broken and fall to the ground due to %s's successive attacks, but are regenerated.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, haha. There's no end.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s. It's done now!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, please take care of the remaining monsters. It'll just take a moment.
(Hilda removes a leaf from Medea's staff and walks towards Dmitri.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kkkkkk. The more I fight with you, the more I feel a soul inside you. If only the soul blessed by God was swallowed like this... .」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's so bad that someone who was a god became a devil and covets the soul of life.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kkkkkk. “It’s funny that someone who can’t do anything would say something like that.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, what are you going to do?
(Hilda grins and slightly cuts the tip of her index finger with a dagger. The liquid that flows out from the slit drips onto the leaves she obtained from Medea.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Like this!
(With those words, Hilda sprinkles the blood collected on the leaves towards Dmitri.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kkkkkk. “If you are willing to become a sacrifice, you will accept this insult.”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm sorry you took it as an insult. I didn't know that I would be able to use the power that even the gods feared like this.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, go and destroy as much as you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Quick!
(At that moment, Dmitry swings his sword, aiming for %s's gap. He barely dodges, but is pushed back by the strong impact.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kkkkkk. Do you believe that a weak being would dare to surpass me? “You will offer your souls to Me here.”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don't know if I can jump over it... . I create something that didn't exist, and even if something disappeared, I make it appear again.
(No sooner has Hilda finished speaking than Adventurer enters behind Dmitry and destroys his wings.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「… You're wasting time with useless words. Just play it and that’s it.”
(Dmitry seems embarrassed and touches the empty wing and screams in pain so that the entire Hellepol Fortress reverberates.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!!!」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The part that should be played is blocked and it just goes back inward. I will embrace you as you are trapped in the stone statue.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Then you will become one with the statue, never being able to go outside... .

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Aaaah… , there is no way a mere human would do something like this.  Even if he was influenced by Hecate... .」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I am a witch... . At the cost of hurting myself, you can no longer stand up. It makes it unplayable anymore.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So I don’t know if Ouroboros wants it… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, what are you doing? Hurry up and finish… … .
(At that time, Dmitry grabs Hilda’s wrist.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kaaah! Do you think I will collapse like this!!”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let go of this!!

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “I will grab you and jump into the abyss!! You... … ! “Kaaaaaa!!”
(Dmitry creates a dark shadow on one side while struggling in pain as his whole body splits apart.)
(But even for a moment, Dmitry's arm, which was creating the shadow, falls to the floor and crumbles into powder.)
(The demon statue struggles again and tries to grab Adventurer, but it collapses from the approaching attack.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Dmitri, you knew the end from the moment you became the devil yourself.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Are you laughing at me…?” ?」

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A person who is twisted and foolish... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Hilda, I think you will destroy yourself if you leave it like this... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Only when this self disappears will we be able to see what we are looking for.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, who are you talking about? ah… … .
(A boy with bandages on his head and legs, holding a glass in one hand, approaches the group.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hello everyone. I have no intention of fighting, so don't be on guard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Menoiti… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why is the twisted one here?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Meno… . Why are you here... . I believe you disappeared at that time... .」

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Dmitry, be quiet. I'm talking about it.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: %s, I'll help you guys get to the next area.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is that it?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Yeah. That's it. Instead, leave Dmitry’s disposal to me. I'd be better off dealing with someone who was once a god than a human.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “How dare these things make me…” … .」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Even so, how can I trust you?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: How can I believe it? Ah, yes. Would you believe me if I told you the story of the witch Daphne?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Daphne is so amazing. I don't know how they even manipulated Dmitry's memories to get in there. I couldn't do that either. Hehehe. Now,

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: %s. Thank you for accepting my prank last time. I'm giving it to you in return.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: What you are looking for is there. Daphne hid it very carefully.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Have you been watching everything?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: It's a trade secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, Medea. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … It seems like something has appeared somewhere in Lindos Shrine due to %s's attack a while ago.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: West of where we met, right?
(Menoiti smiles at %s who is looking at him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All you have to do is believe it and go for it... .

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then it goes down quickly.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hello, goodbye.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Dmitry.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: “Meno, what are you going to do with me… .」

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: I'm literally thinking of getting rid of it. Unlike you, I got something called ‘opportunity’. So, I will live anew in the present time.
(Menoiti shakes the chalice and it fills with water.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Me. Meno. Okay, stop. Oh, you can't do that... .」

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Dmitry, congratulations on becoming a devil. The feeling of guilt disappeared because we weren't in the same category. That's a relief, isn't it?
(The water in the chalice begins to boil little by little. After a moment, Menoiti pours water on Dmitri's broken head.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Kwaaaa!!」

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Even if you hadn't asked me to run away first... . If only I had kept my promise to help Hecate... .

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Keuuuu… Off… .」
(Dmitri's voice can no longer be heard.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: This world would be several times more beautiful now... .

steps.name: caller of giants
steps.objective:
1. Go to the place where [Hilda] was hiding in 「Lindos Shrine」. 
2. Meet a new character there and come back to report the quest to [Hilda].

lines.text: (Hilda comes out of Hellepol Fortress, stops for a moment and looks back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's take a short break.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Have you lost blood and become unwell?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't worry. Look, it's nothing.
(Hilda shows the tip of her index finger, which she stabbed with a dagger a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looks okay.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Everything that wasn't okay during that time was because of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What can I say... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't worry about such trivial things.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait, you two… . Would you like to look behind you?
(As Mediah says, Adventurer and Hilda look at the entrance to Hellepol Fortress.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Look where the Colossus you admired is looking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? uh… . It's true. Looking west.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Did the short, twisted man keep his promise? Dmitry's energy within Hellepol Fortress has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The monsters that followed Dmitri's words no longer chase us.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, is this in perfect shape…? So, can it be made into something like a sphere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Powder?
(Hilda quietly passes something contained in a leaf to Medea.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It appears that it fell from Dmitry.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought it might be useful, so I took some.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, what are you going to use this for?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I can't say that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, I need some time. Items that come from beings that have become demons must first be purified... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So how will you receive it after it is completed? I think it would be a good idea to leave it to Glinda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'll go to Dorothy's village and get it. ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I wish you weren't in Dorothy's village at that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Your relationship isn't as bad as you think.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … We're not on bad terms, but the situation is bad. Uh, Medea… . Look over there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … Uh, that… .
(Something is running in the wind from the west, where the group was looking.)
Briaros!!
(Almost collides with the group, but fortunately passes everyone and heads somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what? That suspicious thing... . I think that's what you're saying... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … It looks like a prisoner.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Briaros? It's the name of a giant... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The giant who made weapons and statues here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I heard it once. I don’t remember who I heard it from, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda? Where are you going?!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, let’s follow along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Medea.
Briaros… … … .
Ha, even though I know Briaros isn’t there, I… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I guess they were quite close to me as they called my name and looked for me.
That's right, Briaros... .
But who are you?
(When Hilda appears, the female beast with the legs of a horse steps back. And when she senses presence, she raises her sword and stands guard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, were you here? uh… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That person... .
Hero? Uh, Daphne? Ah, someone who looks similar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know Daphne?
(The female prisoner puts down the sword she was holding and looks at the %s party.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Seeing as I know Daphne, the story will be quick.
Daphne told you to look for something here?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes.
What did you do with the demon statue in Hellepol? You can't deal with that using normal methods.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … I defeated it, but the twisted one must have come and finished it off.
Did you knock it down? A twisted person has come?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, we need to sort things out.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Then Media will sort it out.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, can I explain this to you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .
Then, tell me why you came here and what happened here so that I can understand.
Before that, I should tell you who I am.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I am Tyrrhenia, a descendant of the Chiron clan.
(The woman who introduced herself as Tyrrhenia pricks her ears.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am Medea... It is said.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm Hilda, that's %s.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then I will tell you. We... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (Medea summarizes and conveys to Tyrrhenia the reasons for coming to the Holy Land of Lindos.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I understand why you came here and what happened to Lindos. I was wondering when I would be able to repay my debt to Daphne... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I guess that was today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So are you helping me?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Does that happen?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Looking at Tyrrenia’s reaction, I think there’s more to it… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If it were Daphne, she would have made Tyrrhenia do something.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I'll tell you that's half right. So should I tell my story... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I heard it from Daphne. That time was called ‘twilight’. I'm probably the person who was there at that time.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It's not exact, but it was around that time.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The one who was a god fell and became a being no better than a devil. I came down to the village where I lived to take the soul of a living being.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I don't really remember what happened, but some spirit saved me... . And Lindos brought me here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of spirit was it?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It was a spirit with a strange way of speaking. He quickly disappeared, saying it would be safe here, but then… .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The demon that ruined our village has come after us. At that time, he was like a god, but he became a corrupted devil... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Was it Dmitri? .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: That's right. The moment Dmitry was about to take my soul, a very large person appeared, grabbed Dmitry, and lured him somewhere.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then, he appeared from where I was hiding and held out his hand. They say they captured the devil and prevented it from coming out again... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: That was my first meeting with Briaros. We became friends after that, and I got a lot of help from him.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I found out later that the demon world was collecting the souls of people like me.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Anyway, Briaros reassured me that since he was a giant, demons and demons would not come easily.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: And gave me a space where I could stay safe. Right there… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?!
(As Tyrrhenia continues her story, the Lindos Shrine suddenly shakes.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: … It's no big deal. It's just that I, the owner of the place, have been out for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Follow me. I'll explain the rest as I go.
(As soon as she finished speaking, Tyrrhenia left the space where the group was and ran as fast as she could.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Could you please adjust the speed so I can keep up? .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It wouldn't have gone far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think the space that Tyrrhenia is the owner of may have what we are looking for.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: To what extent was Daphne involved? .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, let’s go to where we were just a moment ago.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If it is a safe space created by a giant... . Hmm, I guess I have no choice but to go first… .

steps.name: each person's promise
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Shrine」 and enter 「Iron Trial」.
2. Defeat [Tyrrenia] in “Iron Trial” and obtain <Black Moon Fragment>. Then report the quest to [Hilda] in “Lindos Holy Land.”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Were you here?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: You waited. Why is it so slow?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … There is a physical difference, but if you say so... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, Medea. I’m angry.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, are you mad?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You seem angry... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Sorry. I ended up running fast without even realizing it.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Now I want to take you to the place I guard. With ‘Ordeal of Iron’… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Iron ordeal... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: This is the space where Briaros made weapons. There are remnants of metal left in his hands that did not form a perfect weapon.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: You can think of it as the cradle and grave of weapons.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Thanks to Briaros, I was able to stay safe in Lindos. Impure people seeking his weapons came every day, but he protected them.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then, passages leading to the demonic city of Pandemonium appeared throughout the continent.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I think it was called Pseudaria... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Pseudaria… .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Do you know?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Let's go in and talk about the rest.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: As the master of the Iron Ordeal, I will allow you to enter. The ordeal of iron is this way.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Can you see the big sword among the clouds?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, there was nothing until just now... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: This path appears only after neutralizing the demon statue. It's kind of like a device, but it's a bit complicated to explain.  Briaros designed it that way from the beginning.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Now that Dmitri is gone, the road here will not be closed forever.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If the road is closed, there's no way to get out.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Because there is no reason to come out.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: If you walk without thinking, you will see new things. Now, follow me. This time, I'll tailor it to you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's an iron ordeal... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think there's still something left...)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It's here.
(As you walk through the clouds along Tyrrhenia, the scenery you see changes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are weapons stuck in the cliffs and rocks... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Things that cannot or should not be used.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That thing was all made by a giant named Briaros. They are all different in size and type. Moreover, the energy it gives off is different... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It somehow reminds me of a sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Sanctuary?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is where the battle angels and valkyries are.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I thought everyone was gone. I hope you all are doing well. Michaela, Rafaella, and Gabriela... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela is in the Sanctuary, and Rafaela is in the Aegir Ruins... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: What about Gabriela?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't met you yet.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I see. I want to go see you sometime... . There was a time when several people came to make weapons.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Briaros put a lot of effort into making the weapon. He also sparred with me to check his performance.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think he said it's been a while since he came out... . Haven't you been able to come out for a while?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It was some time after the time called twilight that Briaros disappeared.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: You said earlier that the gates of the Demon World appeared all over the continent, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then one person came. Everyone called him a warrior.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The hero said that Briaros' weapon was needed to close the door. Briaros made a condition that he would give you a weapon if you passed a few tests.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Among them, there was a condition for sparring with me. I remember being satisfied with a pretty good weapon.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: However, not long after the hero returned, a huge number of demons attacked Lindos.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: As soon as Briaros saw those demons, he put everything that was outside in here. Even me... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: At that time, I thought we would meet again,

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The door didn't open for a long time... . Of course I couldn't go out, and I couldn't see Briaros either.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then the door opened, and what appeared in front of me was not Briaros, but a demon. They were aiming for a weapon and forced the door open.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: There was something that demon didn't know. You can get what you want by following the rules here, but you don't.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Rules? Did Briaros decide?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: That's right. The rule is to defeat Briaros one-on-one. Instead of Freeling, it's Puriring, and the one protecting this place right now is me, not the giant.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: So I dealt with it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So what you're saying is that we have to follow those rules too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It literally seems like an ordeal... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: What do you think? Would you like to try it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's annoying.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I thought it wouldn't be easy. By the way, who among us can deal with Tyrrhenia?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: %s. I wish it were you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I want to compete with you, who has been blessed by God. I heard you had a fight with Dmitri? I'm curious. Plus, Daphne recommended you... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: How Daphne helped Tyrrhenia... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I'll tell you about that when I get to where I'll be waiting. I promise.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It looks like it wants to fight properly... . I can't help but think that's the only way to get what you want, haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Tyrrenia, I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I'll go first and wait.
(With those words, Tyrrhenia runs towards the inside of the Iron Ordeal at high speed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It somehow feels like that place in Elysia.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That place was created by Hecate's whim. Well, it might be a little different here.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, %s… . Look ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It hasn't even started yet and it's already coming.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s. Are you ready?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The preparations are over. Well, shall we go now?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, Hilda. You cannot let your guard down. be careful!

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's annoying. ha… .
(Hilda sighs softly when she sees the monsters lying on the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this all there to protect the weapons made by the giant? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even so, what are these beastmen that look similar to Tyrrhenia? ?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought you knew... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is the spirit that is with Tyrrhenia. It seems that the spirits who made weapons together with the giants naturally resembled each other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then Tyrrhenia… ?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's just you and me, Medea.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You must have put in a lot of effort yourself to train in a place with special power and spar with a battle angel.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … This space… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, why?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have a feeling that the giant Briaros might have other abilities besides creating weapons and statues.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Considering that Tyrrhenia has controlled this space so that it is not dangerous, well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, look there.
(Tyrenia is standing at the edge of the cliff pointed out by Mediah, looking at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There you are. uh?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, avoid!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes!
Boom!
(With a loud sound, the shield rotates while stuck in the ground. Tyrrhenia then comes down from the cliff and charges.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh!
(Adventurer, which tried to fight back, is pushed far away by a strong impact.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Hilda and Medea step back. Anyone who gets involved in this fight from now on will get nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's a bit shameful to attack without warning... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Are you ready?
(Tyrrenia picks up the dropped shield and points her sword at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't come this far without any determination.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: If so, try doing it right.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: See if you can take it from me!

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Ugh.
(Tyrrenia is pushed back by %s's strong attack. She tries to fight back, but her legs become weak and she falls down.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: This can't be... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Haha… . I can't help it. I lost. I'll admit defeat... .
(Tyrrenia sits down, sighs, takes something out of her arms, and hands it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Daphne left it to me. I will give it to you as promised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This is Hecate’s… .
(The crescent-shaped black stone sparkles purple in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Seeing the two of them being surprised, I guess this isn't an ordinary item.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It is an object symbolizing the ancient god Hecate.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I don't know what kind of god Hecate is, but anyway, I should tell Daphne the story of when I received this.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The Demon World passageway named Pseudaria did not appear for a while, but reappeared not long ago.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: At that moment, this space shook and demons and demons poured out.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Just when I thought I was going to die because I couldn't stop them all by myself, that's when Daphne appeared.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The sight of making enemies fight each other with hand gestures and immobilizing enemies by tapping a staff was truly amazing.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: After everything was over, he held my hand and lifted me up, telling me to hold on like Briaros. He said he would do the same... .

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: He entrusted this to me and asked me to pass it on to Medea and Hilda, who will visit here someday.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It's the same thing, but it will have different meanings for us... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Medea, Hilda. here… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you.
(The moment Medea and Hilda receive the piece of black moon and hold it in their hands, they collapse.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, Hilda!!
(A startled Adventurer hurries to grab Medea and Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's nothing. I felt dizzy for a moment... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It’s okay… . It's no big deal... . It's really okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Right… .
(Medea and Hilda are speechless when they see the piece of black moon in their hands.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The two seem to have realized something... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sorry, I can't tell Tyrrhenia.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I have a guess, but I won't ask. I'm sure you'll be sad when you find out.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you for your understanding.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Are you going back now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are things you need to do to prepare for danger. I'm going to go back and prepare.
(After hearing %s's words, Tyrrhenia smiles and approaches closer. Then, they gently press their foreheads together.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I hope you do well. This is a greeting unique to our clan.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Tyrrhenia.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Tyrrhenia. But what are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Me? We must continue to protect Briaros' legacy. That's why I'm here.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It's not enough compared to Briaros, but if you still need my help, come see me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Want to become a blacksmith?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Well, that's it. Oh, next time I come here, there won't be any fighting other than sparring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's time to spar.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Sigh, it’s such a shame to let it go like this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tyrrenia, are you sure we should spar?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Do you guys want to eat something?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm good. I just wanted to drink tea... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then may I ask for some hot water? There are tea leaves with a nice aroma.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Oh, of course.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, Hilda, how about taking a break?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I was hungry, so that was good.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why are you asking my doctor? I already decided... . okay. I'll eat and leave. By the way, what is the menu? Is it delicious?

steps.name: message in pieces
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Holy Land」, and go to where [Hilda] is hiding.
2. After the story is over, report the quest to [Medea] in “Lindos Holy Land.”

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Tyrrhenia. There's no need to come out here.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you for seeing me off.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It's been a while since I've had a time like this, so I had a lot of fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Tyrrhenia.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Next time I come here, I hope something bad doesn't come.
(Tyrrenia smiles slightly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay.
(Tyrrenia says goodbye with the Chiron clan's unique greeting method. Then, she quickly runs back towards the road leading to the Iron Trial.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As Tirrenia said, I will have to meet you next time for something good.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's how it should be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: A piece of the black moon. Shouldn’t you know why you’re here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, are you going to say that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda. Can I speak first?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Instead, let's go to where I was hiding instead of here. If you're going to talk about something important, it's better to be careful.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: After coming back, I think I understand why Hilda insists on staying here.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If you just slightly control the flow of magical energy, the sound will not leak out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the perfect place to hide... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You interrupted that. Ha, let's stop talking about that.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Media… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .
(Medea takes out a piece of the black moon and holds it up in the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The moment I received this, a scene came to mind. Somewhere, Daphne was holding this and talking to me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Would you like me to help you for a moment?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… ? ah… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, hand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Give me your hand for a moment. hand. Yes, that's right.
(The moment Adventurer held Hilda’s hand, the image of a familiar person vaguely came to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne?

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: “Media.”

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: “If you get this, you will be with the person of the goddess. “I shouldn’t have had to go through this process, and I’m sorry.”

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: “Child, I wanted you to be happy. “That’s why I didn’t want you to set foot this night.”

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: “I got a promise from the demon lord that he wouldn’t touch you, but that was also wrong. I shouldn't have trusted the demons... .」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: “You take charge of what greedy Lux wanted. “Go back to Kali Village and keep it in a quiet place.”

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: “You will keep it well. And there is no need to worry.”

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: “It was quite difficult, but we made it so that no one who would not be kind to you would remember or enter Kali Village.”

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「… Leave the rest to me... … . This is my last... .」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: “Promise… … … … .」
(Daphne's illusion disperses and is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's just as I saw it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's what Lux wanted, then... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This piece of black moon contains the power of people like Hilda and me... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … Daphne… . What on earth was Daphne thinking…? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did Hilda see?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … %s. Now, hands.
(As Hilda holds Adventurer's hand again, an unfamiliar scene different from before comes to mind in a blur.)
(The giant runs toward someone approaching Lindos. The apparent enemy extends his hand toward the giant, but the giant rejects it.)
(The enemy lightly deflects the giant's attack, taunts, and destroys all of the giant's weapons.)
(There is only one thing left. The giant takes out a large sword equipped with a cannon and runs towards the enemy.)
Boom.
(The enemy is pushed back by the giant's attack, and something he was wearing falls to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glasses… ?
(The giant grabs the fallen enemy and tries to stab his heart, but suddenly vomits blood and falls down. Then, his body turns into a broken statue and breaks apart.)
(The giant's weapon disappears in the hands of his former enemy. At the end of that appearance, all illusions of Lindos' past evaporate.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Haha… , Daphne… . It's so crazy... ?
(Hilda, who was watching this, sits down.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why are you showing me this... ? Briaros chose himself to protect this place... . This is not what I wanted... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To become Deicide, someone who kills God... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What I needed was a place to hide away from Ouroboros... . Daphne probably knows that too... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If I get caught by Agashura, Ouroboros will come find me. When Ouroboros comes, everything disappears... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Everyone will die... . Then it will end... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, come to your senses.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, there is a way.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What is that... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go to Kali with Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It may seem like he's doing something crazy, but it might just be his own consideration.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I admit it's crazy, but I don't know if it's consideration.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you for the offer, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay there for now. You'll be fine as long as you're with Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, if you want to receive what I entrusted to you, please follow me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ha, that’s shameful… .
(Hilda touches her forehead and sighs. Then, she holds Medea’s outstretched hand and stands up.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I lost. You can go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well done, Medea. So are you going straight to Cali?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is no direct road from Lindos to Cali, so you have to take Via Oscar. Let’s go there together.

steps.name: Goodbye, goodbye again
steps.objective: 1. Talk to [Hilda] in “Lindos Shrine” and go to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road.” And when the story is over, report the quest to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This road… , It’s amazing to see it again. I just threw the spirit, and it connected to Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: When you throw a mandarava, a path appears?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did as Glinda told me, and it really worked.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Looks like Glinda put something in the mandalaba. By the way, Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Can we stop by Dorothy's Village before going to Cali? I want to say hello to Glinda and Bina... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Of course. Because I'm here, you don't have to worry about %s.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, let's go. Medea, let’s go too.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Spirit, you are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava? Why is there no answer?
(Adventurer looks at the mandarava lying on the rock and shakes it.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Aaaah, I’m dizzy! The sunlight was just so good that I lost my mind!
(Mandarava comes to his senses and struggles in %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Medea? Hilda? You guys left separately, why are you here?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: No. no! That's not what's important. Hilda, listen to me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why? What's going on?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Hurry up and leave here. hurry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Spirit, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It seems like there are people in Glaston that Hilda doesn't want to meet the most.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Mandarava, how did you know that?
