lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I am a spirit. You may know or you may not know. Don't talk nonsense and leave quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you come to Glaston... ?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, I think you'll have to go to town alone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, as the spirit said, there is no time to stay like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's okay. It's okay.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Listening to Mandarava, I feel more anxious... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's safe to go here.  This is a tunnel leading to Riftrasir.
(When Mandarava touches the rock next to him, a large cave appears with a popping sound.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Since when has something like this been around?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Are you not going?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, let’s go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, don't worry about Hilda and me and go back to town. We will contact you when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Medea. Goodbye Hilda too.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, goodbye.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Bye bye.
(Hilda and Medea say hello to Mandarava and Adventurer and then quickly leave the road.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, let's go to town now.
(The mandarava floats up and sits on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I enjoyed all the sunshine. The leaves on the head are also fresh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it time to go in now?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You have to go in and rest. Oh, I have a secret, and I'll let you in on it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Secret?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Daphne appeared in front of me. He came with extremely good, high-quality cotton and asked me to do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you ask for?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I asked that Hilda and Medea be allowed to leave properly. He also said it was for Glinda’s benefit. You know what that means. yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, a little… .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I asked the goddess just in case, and she said it was okay. I heard that the one for Hilda was for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, I understand.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Now we're leaving for the village!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Uh… ?
(Mandarava raises his head and looks at the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The movements of the spirits in Glaston changed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: No. It's good. The ominous energy that had made people shake their heads disappeared at once. Oh, it's fascinating.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I don't know because I'm not a local spirit there. Let's go to the village first, let's go!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Did you see the mandrake drying next to me? This guy was drying up with a happy expression on his face.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello Mandarava. I'll go first. I'll tell Glinda I didn't see you.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Look. friend. please. help me help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha… . okay. Then, will you help me later too?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Yeah. It's a promise!
(Adventurer has no choice but to look for herbs with Mandarava and runs around here and there.)
(Not knowing that someone was watching from above the fountain in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hahaha, funny spirit. %s as well. It's all fun.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Sigh, now Lux is looking for wings to destroy it... .

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Are you still there?
(When Menoiti looks down into the fountain, Mandrake, who was soaking inside, is startled.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Now go back.
(The frightened Mandrake comes out of the fountain and runs to where the Mandarava is.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hehehe. It's sorted out to some extent.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: So should I just wait a little longer?
